Three ways in

Felt. Heard. Seen.

Bilateral stimulation is a steady left-right rhythm. The pebbles deliver it three ways. Use one, or all three together, depending on where you are and what the moment needs.

Touch

Soft haptic pulses under each thumb, one side and then the other.

Best for the desk, the commute, a meeting about to begin.

Sound

A gentle tone that travels from one ear to the other, through your headphones.

Best for eyes closed, lights low, the last ten minutes of the day.

Light

A quiet glow that crosses from one pebble to the other, for your eyes to follow.

Best for a dark room, or when you want something to watch.

The founder's story

It started at home, at 3 AM.

At home

Two years ago, I began noticing something unsettling. My spouse struggled to sleep night after night. My father woke repeatedly through the night. My mother-in-law silently battled chronic insomnia that slowly drained her energy and mood.

Everyone looked functional. Very few were truly rested.

The sleep lab

When my wife needed a hospital sleep study, the waiting list stretched close to two months. That is when it hit me: we are living through a silent sleep crisis, and most of the help on offer is clinical, expensive or impossible to sustain.

On the cushion

Meditation had been my own way of steadying myself for years. I have sat two ten-day Vipassana courses: ten days of noble silence, long hours of sitting, attention moving through the body one sensation at a time.

Those twenty days changed how I understand calm. It is not something you argue yourself into. The body settles first, and the mind follows.

Two courses. Twenty days of silence.

Calm is not a thought. It is something the body learns, and can return to.

The question

But I could not ask my father, my wife or a founder answering calls at midnight to sit for ten days. So I went looking for what busy people actually do to switch off. That search became the SLEAP Playbook: one hundred conversations across Bengaluru.

The pebbles

Between the cushion and those conversations, the pebbles took shape. A small, physical rhythm you can hold, asking nothing of you except a thumb on each side. They are not meditation, and they are not therapy. They are a way back into the body, for people who may never sit for ten days.

Shubho Broto · Founder, SLEAP · Bengaluru
Alongside care

At home. At work. With your therapist.

Bilateral stimulation is part of EMDR, a therapy practised by trained professionals around the world. SLEAP brings the rhythm into everyday life. It supports your practice and your therapist's work. It does not replace either.

Use it for

Calm, focus and winding down. A daily rhythm practice you can carry in your pocket.

Use it with

Your own routine, or alongside your therapist's work if you are in therapy.

It is not

EMDR therapy or a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition.

Honest answers

What you may be wondering.

The pebbles are new, and we would rather be clear about what they are, and are not, than oversell them.

What are SLEAP Pebbles?

Two small, wireless ceramic pebbles, one for each hand. They pulse in turn, left and then right, through gentle vibration, a soft tone and a quiet light. You choose the speed, intensity, direction and length of each session.

What is bilateral stimulation?

A steady left-right rhythm delivered through touch, sound or sight. It sits at the heart of EMDR, and many people find the alternating pattern grounding and calming.

Is SLEAP a form of EMDR therapy?

No. SLEAP Pebbles are a wellness tool inspired by the bilateral stimulation used in EMDR. EMDR therapy is delivered by a trained professional. If you are in therapy, ask your therapist how the pebbles could fit alongside it.

How do I use them?

Hold one in each hand with your thumbs resting in the dish. Choose touch, sound, light or any mix, then set your speed, intensity, direction and session length. Breathe, and let the rhythm lead.

Are they wireless?

Yes. The pebbles connect over Bluetooth and charge in a portable case, so you can use them at your desk, on the move or in bed.

How are the pebbles connected to the SLEAP Playbook?

The SLEAP Playbook is our ongoing study of how 100 of Bengaluru's most accomplished people switch off, sleep, wake and recharge. It sorts every ritual by six levers. The pebbles were designed around three of them, body, sound and sight, for the switch-off, sleep and recharge parts of the day.

When can I get a pair?

We are building the first batch in Bengaluru. Waitlist members hear first and get first-batch priority.

Who should check with a professional first?

If you have a medical or mental-health condition, are pregnant, or use an implanted medical device, speak to a qualified healthcare professional before use. If you have a diagnosed sleep disorder such as insomnia or sleep apnoea, please keep working with your doctor.

Why the name SLEAP?

Sleep, with a leap in the middle: a short, deliberate jump from the way you rest now to the way your body already knows how to.

There is a quieter meaning too. A group of leopards is called a leap: still and deeply at rest, then fully alert when it matters.
